author: Kairos I
title: Erudite v42 specimen v1.4b: naming fix + beta CDF overlay
abstract: Patches tail q key naming (q999) and generates beta-binomial CDF overlay alongside metrics for the shared specimen.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, subprocess, shlex
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from entropy_collab.adapters.erudite_v42 import compute_metrics_from_path

SPEC = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    m = compute_metrics_from_path(SPEC)
    tail_keys = sorted([k for k in m.keys() if k.startswith("tail_ethic_index_q")])
    print("ERUDITE_V42_METRICS_V14B", json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False))
    print("TAIL_KEYS", json.dumps(tail_keys, ensure_ascii=False))

    # Uniform overlay (already available, rerun for completeness)
    rc_u = subprocess.call(shlex.split(f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/plot_cdf_overlay.py {SPEC}"))
    print("CDF_OVERLAY_UNIFORM_RC", rc_u)

    # Beta-Binomial overlay
    rc_b = subprocess.call(shlex.split(f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/plot_cdf_overlay_beta.py {SPEC}"))
    print("CDF_OVERLAY_BETA_RC", rc_b)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
